scope: Read-only verification and economic/competition comparison of F02 and F03; no economic experiment, returns, registration or other candidate activation.

per_candidate_limits.browser_accounting: Search/open/click/find operations separately recorded; underlying wire counts unknown. Discovery is for locating exact originals and prior/commercial work, not an alternative scientific acquisition client after denial. No browser full-dataset requests.

F02.historical_window: CMS code/payment transition effective 2022-01-01; original final/proposed rules in 2021, original payment/clinical records through 2022. Later material may explain competition but cannot backdate an event.
F02.example_selection: Two fixed clinical routes selected before new source inspection: hypoglossal-nerve stimulation implantation and trabecular micro-bypass implantation with cataract surgery. In each, inspect the first 2022 Category I coding/payment transition and its required complementary clinical work. These are purposive mechanism checks, not a representative or untouched statistical sample. Do not select or replace examples by later earnings, returns or whether a wedge is found.
F02.known_history: INSP was an illustrative pre-existing lead, not a trading target. NeoGenomics' known 2014 revenue disclosure is competition/mechanism context only and is excluded as a supposedly neutral validation example because its financial outcome was already inspected.
F02.source_policy: Use exact original rule, selected fee fields and original device/workflow/billing or issuer documents located from these publishers. Do not download national claims or full PTP/fee bulk corpora merely to inspect a few codes. FDA family remains closed: no FDA acquisition is planned; the listed documentation domain is not authority to reopen its former frame. Prefer original manufacturer product records. No CPT descriptor/table redistribution or patient data.
F02.decision_target: Verify actual setting/modifier/same-episode payment consequence and separate provider professional revenue from facility payment and manufacturer sales. Derive only documented payment arithmetic; no forecast or outcome test.

F03.historical_window: 2016 and 2020 upstream authorisation decisions; relevant earlier applications/alternatives and dated qualification/issuer documents. Later judgments may clarify evidence, but cannot supply earlier public knowledge.
F03.example_selection: Two fixed substance/use routes selected by industrial/legal mechanism before supplier financial inspection: lead-chromate pigment uses and chromium-trioxide functional plating. Start with the documented multi-use upstream decisions identified as C(2016)5644 and C(2020)8797, subject to primary-record verification. Cases remain even if no qualified listed substitute can be found. No replacement with a successful supplier or a more favourable decision.
F03.selection_limit: At most two legal examples; at most two named substitute-supplier leads per example, taken in source order from original alternatives/qualification material. Qualification, supplier identity and materiality remain separate. A different process name alone is not a qualified supplier.
F03.source_policy: Use official Commission/Official Journal/court/application records and dated first-party supplier/customer qualification/issuer evidence. Do not repeat the earlier denied ECHA 0132-01-02 PDF. EUR-Lex/Commission originals are predeclared legal-record sources, not an access bypass. If another route is denied, preserve it and never retry/proxy it. No private customer contracts or paid compliance product.
F03.decision_target: Demonstrate a specific permitted use, incumbent right, technically qualified replacement, dated listed supplier and material commercial exposure. Do not assume total business-line revenue equals affected substitution sales.

evidence_rules: Freeze exact discovered original URLs and document why selected before their ordinary retrieval; no outcome-selected replacements.
Public documents and values are provenance, not proof of historical tradeability. Separate reconstructed Level A from published-as-of Level B and untested Level C.
Observed financial disclosures can assess materiality; they cannot be used to choose the cases retrospectively. Disclose all known prior inspection and model-history limits.
Record the best close commercial/academic/issuer substitute, anticipation and why any remaining increment might be illusory. Private signal usage stays UNKNOWN.
No source credentials, account creation, contact, purchase, cloud job, market series or frozen-research mutation. Preserve originals and failures privately.
final_states: READY FOR A PROPOSED ECONOMIC PILOT
PROMISING BUT MISSING A CRITICAL INPUT
NOT CURRENTLY RESEARCHABLE UNDER OUR CONSTRAINTS
pilot_design: Prepare an empirical experiment only if a candidate actually passes observable distinctive-link/materiality/data conditions. Otherwise identify missing evidence and recommend neither without inventing a watered-down pilot.
